req.title: Create new post
req.statement: The system shall insert a new post attributed to the logged-in user when POST /create receives a title and body, then redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /create must insert a new post attributed to the logged-in user and redirect to /. I design: (1) a positive EP test confirming 302 redirect and DB row insertion with correct author_id, title, body; (2) a negative NEG test confirming that an unauthenticated POST is rejected (redirected to login, no row inserted); (3) a boundary BVA test with an empty title (minimum invalid input) confirming no insertion and flash error; (4) a DT test covering the missing-title decision branch explicitly; (5) a STC test verifying the state transition from logged-in to post-created to redirect-to-index. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_create_post_authenticated_inserts_row_and_redirects
preconditions: App initialised with test DB containing fixture user id=1 (test/test)
actions: POST /create with title='Hello World', body='Some body text'
expected: DB contains a new post row with title='Hello World', body='Some body text', author_id=1
trace: R-FLASKR-015: post row inserted; 302 redirect to /
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

# Login
lr = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
assert lr.status_code == 302

# Create post
cr = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Hello World', 'body': 'Some body text'})
assert cr.status_code == 302
assert cr.headers['Location'] == '/'

# Verify DB row
with app.app_context():
    db = get_db()
    row = db.execute(
        "SELECT title, body, author_id FROM post WHERE title = 'Hello World'"
    ).fetchone()
    assert row is not None
    assert row['title'] == 'Hello World'
    assert row['body'] == 'Some body text'
    assert row['author_id'] == 1

os.unlink(path)

from flaskr.db import get_db

    assert row['author_id'] == 2

tests.name: test_create_post_state_transition_logged_in_to_post_exists
preconditions: System state: user logged in, 1 pre-existing post
actions: POST /create with title='New State Post', body='transition body'
Verify post-state: 2 posts in DB, redirect to /
expected: New row title='New State Post', body='transition body', author_id=1
trace: R-FLASKR-015: state transition from pre-create to post-create verified
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

# Verify pre-state
with app.app_context():
    pre_count = get_db().execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post').fetchone()[0]
assert pre_count == 1

# Login
lr = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
assert lr.status_code == 302

# Transition: create post
cr = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'New State Post', 'body': 'transition body'})
assert cr.status_code == 302
assert cr.headers['Location'] == '/'

# Verify post-state
with app.app_context():
    db = get_db()
    post_count = db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post').fetchone()[0]
    assert post_count == 2
    row = db.execute("SELECT title, body, author_id FROM post WHERE title='New State Post'").fetchone()
    assert row['title'] == 'New State Post'
    assert row['body'] == 'transition body'
    assert row['author_id'] == 1

os.unlink(path)
